attests: Artifacts signed by the StillOS Notary key published at signing_keys verify at verify_url_template, free and without an account. Each artifact carries its own scope in its `proves` field; that scope, and nothing broader, is what the artifact attests.
what_this_does_not_claim: A valid signature does not establish that the underlying claim is true.
Honouring another issuer's artifact is not an endorsement of their judgment.
A treaty entry carries no liability for the other issuer's mistakes and creates no uptime dependency.
No entry here is exclusive. Any entry is revocable by unpublishing it.
key_resolution: per-receipt (notary_fp), historical keys retained in the keyring

bond.note: Our verdicts sit behind a slashable correctness bond. This is offered, not required of anyone honouring our artifacts.

treaties.statement: When an SCVD artifact signed by the key published at counterparty_signing_key is presented to us and verifies, we treat it as evidence of exactly what it attests -- its own signature_covers scope and its what-this-does-not-prove text -- and nothing more. No endorsement of SCVD's judgment, no liability for its mistakes, no uptime dependency, no exclusivity. Revocable by unpublishing.
treaties.reciprocity_note: Published unilaterally. A treaty is complete when the counterparty publishes their own statement citing this URL; until then this is our half, standing on its own.
treaties.disclosure_note: SCVD was told this entry exists, in public, on the day it was published. They did not ask for it and have not agreed to it.
treaties.removal_policy: This entry is removed on request from SCVD, without argument and without requiring a reason. Ask at any channel we publish and it comes down.

how_to_be_considered: Publish one statement at a stable URL you control naming our origin, our signing_keys URL, and what you honour our artifacts as. Tell us where it is and we will cite it here. One published statement, zero infrastructure, revocable by either side.
